articles.title: August rainfall fails to reduce India's monsoon deficit
articles.description: India's cumulative monsoon rainfall deficit remains despite August's better-than-expected rains. This deficit has caused a significant acreage gap in kharif crop sowing. Several states, including Bihar and Andhra Pradesh, face substantial rainfall deficits.
